item.title: Faculty of Law, AMU Hosts discussion on the book ‘In Chambers: A Young Lawyer’s Guide to Practice, Ethics and Advocacy’
item.description: Faculty of Law, Aligarh Muslim University hosted a discussion on In Chambers with author Talha Abdul Rahman, focusing on litigation practice, ethics, and professional growth. item.title: Supreme Court Lawyers Welfare Trust announces 3 persons selected for JS Verma Fellowship 2026
item.description: The Supreme Court Lawyers Welfare Trust has selected 3 people for the JS Verma Fellowship 2026 Edition, namely, Archita Nigam, Surabhi Vaya, and Mallika Agarwal. item.title: Reliance on WhatsApp chats alone insufficient to grant divorce on grounds of cruelty: Bombay HC
item.description: “Merely relying on the WhatsApp chat, the divorce decree cannot be granted, since it is not proved by leading evidence.” The post Reliance on WhatsApp chats alone insufficient to grant divorce on grounds of cruelty: Bombay HC appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Unverified DVD inadmissible as evidence under Customs Act, 1962; can’t be used to implicate individual: CESTAT
item.description: Electronic record, in the form of the DVD could not be treated as admissible evidence, in the absence of any verification as to its genuineness, veracity or reliability from the original electronic device by/from which these are created, for the purpose of imposition of penalty under Section 114-AA, Customs Act, 1962. The post Unverified DVD inadmissible as evidence under Customs Act, 1962; can’t be used to implicate individual: CESTAT appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Akasa Air breached contract by cancelling 640 festive season bookings; Delhi Court awards travel agency ₹1.08 crore damages
item.description: “In commercial transactions, especially in the travel industry, group bookings for festive periods are made precisely to capitalize on predictable seasonal demand.” The post Akasa Air breached contract by cancelling 640 festive season bookings; Delhi Court awards travel agency ₹1.08 crore damages appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: President appoints Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari as Chief Justice of Madras High Court
item.description: On 26-2-2026, the Supreme Court Collegium recommended his appointment as the Chief Justice of the Madras High Court, consequent upon the retirement of the incumbent Chief Justice. The post President appoints Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari as Chief Justice of Madras High Court appeared first on SCC Times.
